values.note: 18 sites on the booking site: 15 non-electric and 3 electric (17 and 18 are 50-ft, 50-amp pull-throughs; 12 is an 18-ft 30-amp site with no occupancy listed, probably the host's). Listed lengths: eight sites 15 ft, five 25 ft, two 50-ft back-ins (14, 15).

values.note: Booking page: campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days. Arrive before the gate closes (7-10 p.m. by month); no exit until it opens at 7 a.m. Refunds and cancellations by phone to ReserveAmerica.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/south-mountains-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552861 (Booking Window; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'; gate-hours alert), read 2026-10-22

note: Drive-to family campground ~0.5 mi from the Jacob Fork parking area; open after Hurricane Helene (park news, June 2026), though High Shoals Falls and its trail remain closed. Separate equestrian campground excluded. --Claude
summary: Open: the park's Helene-recovery post (June 2026) lists the tent/trailer/RV campground as open; Clear Creek access closed for construction; Wards Gap Road detour. Confirmed 18 sites, 50-amp electric, pull-throughs, showers, ReserveAmerica booking. Added max 50 ft, year-round, status open, 6-month window, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days. Note corrected: 3 electric sites (two 50-amp pull-throughs + a 30-amp site), not one. Fees ($30 / $35 electric incl. $3 reservation fee) stand.
flags: Registry state:NC holiday min_stay waiver says 7 days; the ReserveAmerica booking page says 14 (as at 103/4214). Recorded 14.
Fit: eight of the 18 sites list 15 ft and one 18 ft; nine take a 23-ft rig (25-ft sites 1, 10, 11, 13, 16; 50-ft sites 14, 15, 17, 18).
Access (info): road construction on Wards Gap Road from Oct. 5, 2026 'for the next several weeks'; follow the detour (ncparks.gov alert).
